question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
All the players from this athletic club participated in the tournament and _______ one of them got a medal.
options: none
each
they
all
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "each"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence mentions "All the players," indicating we are referring to a group.
☛ "Each" is correct here because it emphasizes individual members of the group.
☛ The sentence means: "All the players from this athletic club participated in the tournament, and each one of them got a medal."
☛ "None" is incorrect because the sentence conveys a positive outcome.
☛ "They" and "all" are grammatically unsuitable as they disrupt sentence structure.

Grammar Rules:
☛ Each is used to highlight individual members of a group.
☛ It takes a singular verb, e.g., "Each of them has a medal."
☛ "All" refers to the group collectively, e.g., "All of them have medals."
☛ "None" conveys negation and does not fit the context here.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

options_hi: none
each
they
all
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "each"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ वाक्य में "All the players" (सभी खिलाड़ी) का उल्लेख है, जिससे पता चलता है कि हम एक समूह की बात कर रहे हैं।
☛ "Each" का प्रयोग यहाँ इसलिए सही है क्योंकि यह समूह के प्रत्येक सदस्य को अलग-अलग दर्शाता है।
☛ वाक्य का अर्थ है: "इस एथलेटिक क्लब के सभी खिलाड़ियों ने टूर्नामेंट में भाग लिया और प्रत्येक को एक मेडल मिला।"
☛ "None" गलत है क्योंकि वाक्य सकारात्मक परिणाम दर्शाता है।
☛ "They" और "all" व्याकरणिक रूप से अनुचित हैं क्योंकि वे वाक्य संरचना को बिगाड़ते हैं।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Each का प्रयोग समूह के व्यक्तिगत सदस्यों पर जोर देने के लिए किया जाता है।
☛ यह singular verb के साथ प्रयुक्त होता है, जैसे: "Each of them has a medal."
☛ "All" का प्रयोग समूह को सामूहिक रूप से दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है, जैसे: "All of them have medals."
☛ "None" नकारात्मक अर्थ देता है और यहाँ संदर्भ के अनुकूल नहीं है।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The teacher asked the students to _______ attention towards the instructions given for the project.
options: make
keen
had
pay
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "pay"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence requires the correct verb to pair with 'attention'.
☛ 'Pay attention' is a fixed phrase meaning 'to focus or listen carefully'.
☛ Options like 'make attention', 'keen attention', or 'had attention' are grammatically incorrect as they do not form proper collocations.
☛ 'Pay' is a transitive verb that correctly pairs with 'attention' and gives the sentence its intended meaning.

Grammar Rules:
☛ Collocations: Some words naturally go together, like 'pay attention' or 'make a decision'. These cannot be altered.
☛ Transitive Verbs: Verbs like 'pay' require an object. Here, 'attention' acts as the object.
☛ Fixed Phrases: English has certain phrases that are always used in a specific way, and memorizing them is essential for accuracy.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

options_hi: make
keen
had
pay
solution_hi:

☛ 'Pay attention' एक स्थिर वाक्यांश (fixed phrase) है जिसका अर्थ है 'ध्यान देना'।
☛ 'Make attention', 'keen attention', या 'had attention' जैसे विकल्प व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत हैं क्योंकि ये सही संयोजन (collocation) नहीं बनाते।
☛ 'Pay' एक transitive verb है जो 'attention' के साथ सही ढंग से जुड़ता है और वाक्य को सही अर्थ देता है।

Grammar Rules:

☛ Transitive Verbs: 'Pay' जैसी क्रियाओं को object की आवश्यकता होती है। यहाँ 'attention' object के रूप में कार्य कर रहा है।
☛ Fixed Phrases: अंग्रेजी में कुछ वाक्यांश हमेशा एक निश्चित तरीके से प्रयोग किए जाते हैं, जिन्हें याद रखना जरूरी है।

question:

a quick shower
a fast shower
a quick food
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "a quick shower"

Explanation:

☛ 'Fast' is generally used for speed, whereas 'quick' refers to something being done in a short time.
☛ While 'quick meal' or 'quick food' could be used, 'shower' fits better in this context as part of a daily routine.
☛ 'A quick food' is incorrect because 'food' is an uncountable noun and does not take the article 'a'.

Grammar Rules:
☛ 'Quick' vs 'Fast': 'Quick' relates to time, 'Fast' to speed.
☛ Countable and Uncountable Nouns: 'Food' is uncountable, so 'a quick food' is incorrect.
☛ Adjectives must agree with the nouns they describe in terms of meaning and grammar.

options_hi: a fast meal

☛ 'A quick food' गलत है क्योंकि 'food' एक अगणनीय संज्ञा (uncountable noun) है और इसके साथ 'a' का प्रयोग नहीं होता।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Serena _________ from fever since the 5th of this month.
options: is suffering
has been suffering
suffers
suffered
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "has been suffering"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence includes the phrase "since the 5th of this month", which indicates a specific point in time.
☛ When an action started in the past and is still continuing in the present, we use the Present Perfect Continuous Tense.
☛ "Has been suffering" fits this tense, showing that Serena's fever started on the 5th and is still ongoing.
☛ Other options like "is suffering" (Present Continuous), "suffers" (Simple Present), and "suffered" (Simple Past) are incorrect because they do not convey the continuity of the action.

Grammar Rules:
☛ The Present Perfect Continuous Tense is used for actions that began in the past and are still continuing.
☛ Its structure is: Subject + has/have + been + V1 + ing + since/for + time.
☛ "Since" is used with a specific point in time, while "For" is used with a duration.
☛ Example: "He has been working here since 2020." (point in time)
☛ Example: "She has been waiting for two hours." (duration)
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Serena _________ from fever since the 5th of this month.
options_hi: is suffering
has been suffering
suffers
suffered
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "has been suffering"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ वाक्य में "since the 5th of this month" का प्रयोग हुआ है, जो एक निश्चित समय (specific time) को दर्शाता है।
☛ जब किसी क्रिया का प्रारंभ अतीत में हुआ हो और वह वर्तमान में भी जारी हो, तो Present Perfect Continuous Tense का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
☛ "Has been suffering" इसी टेंस का उदाहरण है, जो दिखाता है कि सेरेना बुखार से पीड़ित होना 5th से शुरू हुआ और अभी भी जारी है।
☛ अन्य विकल्प जैसे "is suffering" (Present Continuous), "suffers" (Simple Present), और "suffered" (Simple Past) इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं क्योंकि वे समय की निरंतरता (continuity) को व्यक्त नहीं करते।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Present Perfect Continuous Tense का प्रयोग उन क्रियाओं के लिए किया जाता है जो अतीत में शुरू हुई हों और वर्तमान में भी जारी हों।
☛ इसकी संरचना है: Subject + has/have + been + V1 + ing + since/for + time।
☛ "Since" का प्रयोग निश्चित समय (point of time) के साथ होता है, जबकि "For" का प्रयोग समय की अवधि (duration) के साथ होता है।
☛ उदाहरण: "He has been working here since 2020." (निश्चित समय)
☛ उदाहरण: "She has been waiting for two hours." (अवधि)

question:
Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.
He comes here _________ .
options: quickly
formerly
daily
lately
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "daily"

Explanation:
☛ The sentence requires an adverb of frequency since it indicates how often an action occurs.
☛ "Daily" is the correct choice as it denotes regularity.
☛ Other options like "quickly" (manner), "formerly" (past time), and "lately" (recent time) do not fit the context as they do not express frequency.
☛ Structurally, the adverb follows the verb ("comes") and clarifies time/frequency.

Grammar Rules:
☛ Adverbs of frequency (e.g., always, often, daily) usually come before the main verb but after the 'be' verb.
☛ Examples:
- He always arrives early. (Before main verb)
- She is usually punctual. (After 'is')
☛ Adverbs of manner (e.g., quickly, slowly) follow the verb.
☛ Adverbs of time (e.g., yesterday, lately) typically come at the end of the sentence.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.
He comes here _________ .
options_hi: quickly
formerly
daily
lately
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "daily"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ वाक्य में एक adverb of frequency (आवृत्ति का क्रिया-विशेषण) की आवश्यकता है क्योंकि यह बताता है कि कोई कार्य कितनी बार होता है।
☛ "Daily" (प्रतिदिन) एक सही विकल्प है क्योंकि यह नियमितता दर्शाता है।
☛ अन्य विकल्प जैसे "quickly" (तेजी से), "formerly" (पहले), और "lately" (हाल ही में) इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं क्योंकि वे आवृत्ति नहीं बताते।
☛ वाक्य संरचना के अनुसार, adverb क्रिया ("comes") के बाद आता है और समय/आवृत्ति को स्पष्ट करता है।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Adverbs of frequency (जैसे always, often, daily) आमतौर पर मुख्य क्रिया से पहले आते हैं, लेकिन 'be' verb के बाद आते हैं।
☛ उदाहरण:
- He always comes on time. (मुख्य क्रिया से पहले)
- She is usually late. ('is' के बाद)
☛ Adverbs of manner (जैसे quickly, slowly) क्रिया के बाद आते हैं।
☛ Adverbs of time (जैसे yesterday, lately) वाक्य के अंत में आते हैं।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
She ________ gracefully and greeted the interview committee with respect.
options: grinned

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "smiled"

☛ 'Grinned' and 'smirked' convey informal or disrespectful expressions, which are inappropriate here.
☛ 'Leered' suggests an unpleasant or offensive expression, making it entirely unsuitable.
☛ 'Smiled' is the correct choice as it reflects a polite, positive, and professional demeanor, fitting for a formal context like an interview.

Grammar Rules:
☛ Verb Tense: Simple past tense is used here since the action has already occurred.
☛ Contextual Appropriateness: Word selection must align with the tone and setting of the sentence.
☛ Connotation: Some words carry negative or positive implications, which should be considered while filling blanks.

☛ 'Scent' is a noun that correctly follows the adjective 'strong' in this sentence structure.

Grammar Rules:
☛ Nouns often follow adjectives, e.g., 'strong scent.'
☛ Homophones (words that sound alike but differ in meaning) must be identified carefully.
☛ Always analyze the context of the sentence to choose the right word.

question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Rosy and Nicky couldn’t provide any evidence to support ________ arguments.
options: there
theirs
their
they’re
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "their"

Explanation:
☛ Rosy and Nicky couldn’t provide any evidence to support 'their' arguments. Here, 'their' is correct because it is a possessive adjective showing ownership by multiple people (Rosy and Nicky).
☛ 'There' refers to a place, 'theirs' is a possessive pronoun used alone (e.g., "The book is theirs"), and 'they’re' is a contraction of 'they are', which is irrelevant here.
☛ The blank requires a word to modify the plural noun (arguments), making 'their' grammatically accurate.

Grammar Rules:
☛ Possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, its, our, their) precede nouns to indicate ownership.
☛ Possessive pronouns (mine, yours, his, hers, its, ours, theirs) stand alone and replace nouns.
☛ 'There' vs 'Their': 'There' denotes location; 'Their' denotes possession.
☛ 'They’re' always means 'they are' and functions as a verb in sentences.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Rosy and Nicky couldn’t provide any evidence to support ________ arguments.
options_hi: there
theirs
their
they’re
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "their"

Explanation:
☛ रोज़ी और निकी ने अपने तर्कों को सही साबित करने के लिए कोई सबूत नहीं दिया। यहाँ 'their' का प्रयोग सही है क्योंकि यह एक possessive adjective है जो दो या दो से अधिक लोगों (Rosy और Nicky) की संपत्ति या संबंध को दर्शाता है।
☛ 'There' का अर्थ है 'वहाँ' (स्थान), 'theirs' एक possessive pronoun है जो अकेले प्रयोग होता है (जैसे "The book is theirs"), और 'they’re' 'they are' का संक्षिप्त रूप है, जो यहाँ अर्थहीन है।
☛ यहाँ plural noun (arguments) के पहले possessive adjective (their) का प्रयोग हुआ है, जो व्याकरणिक रूप से सही है।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, its, our, their) संज्ञा से पहले आते हैं और स्वामित्व दिखाते हैं।
☛ Possessive pronouns (mine, yours, his, hers, its, ours, theirs) स्वतंत्र रूप से प्रयोग होते हैं और संज्ञा की आवश्यकता नहीं होती।
☛ 'There' vs 'Their': 'There' स्थान बताता है, जबकि 'Their' स्वामित्व बताता है।
☛ 'They’re' हमेशा 'they are' का संक्षिप्त रूप होता है, जिसका प्रयोग वाक्य में क्रिया के रूप में होता है।

question:

options: celebrated
celebrates
is celebrating
was celebrating
solution:
